candidates.change_summary: Change the assignment of the stored guess hash to set guesses[msg.sender].guess to keccak256(hash) instead of the provided hash.
Store the guess using the zero value (clear the guess) instead of the provided hash.
Set the stored block number to current block rather than next block (block.number instead of block.number + 1).
Set the stored block number to two blocks ahead (block.number + 2) instead of one ahead.
Remove the requirement that msg.value equals 1 ether (delete the value check), allowing any value to be accepted.
Change strict block progression check from '>' to '>=' so settle allows settling in the same block as the locked block, altering when guesses are cleared and potential transfers occur.
Clear the stored guess before computing the answer so the comparison uses a zeroed guess, changing whether transfer happens and the observed state after settle.
Move the line that clears guesses (guesses[msg.sender].block = 0) to after the transfer so state remains set if payout occurs, altering observable state post-settle.
